fact: The KwaZulu-Natal provincial manager of Home Affairs told the Portfolio Committee that the province had 47 connected health facilities but only 13 permanent officials to cover them, which was losing birth registrations within 30 days, and that officials roaming between hospitals in vehicles received in the 2025/26 financial year had improved performance in the fourth quarter; the Western Cape reported 23 connected hospitals for birth registration and the Eastern Cape 23 health facilities, the latter missing its 30-day birth registration target at first for the quarter ending December 2025.
title: KZN, EC & WC DHA Performance & operations; DPWI on DHA Office conditions and space (Deputy Minister)
